test_overview: Evaluated the regression smoke test against the Flask Team Chat app (localhost:8000). Step 1 passed fully (8/8): login UI displayed, alice/password-alice login succeeded, landed on #general with a Channels section containing #general and a Direct Messages section. Step 2 FAILED with a fatal error (0/10): after Bob sent 'Regression test reply from Bob', Alice's un-refreshed context_A did NOT show the message within the required 5-second real-time window (verified by polling 10x500ms plus a snapshot showing only Alice's message); the message only appeared later. Additionally, a severe message-duplication rendering defect was observed in both contexts (messages repeatedly re-appended to the list on each update cycle; Alice's view showed ~12 copies of her message and ~10 copies of Bob's). Because the failed verification was not marked non-fatal, the entire test plan failed: Steps 3 and 4 were not performed and scored 0. Total: 8/40.

steps.description: test_login_with_seeded_user: Opened /, login UI with username/password fields displayed. Logged in as alice/password-alice successfully; landed on #general ('# general' title, user 'Alice Nguyen'). Sidebar shows CHANNELS with #general and a DIRECT MESSAGES section. All verifications (including non-fatal ones) passed.

test_general_messaging_and_realtime: FATAL FAILURE. Alice's message sent and displayed with Alice Nguyen as sender. Bob logged in, landed on #general, and saw Alice's message. Bob sent 'Regression test reply from Bob'. Real-time delivery failed: Bob's message did NOT appear in Alice's un-refreshed view within 5 seconds (10x500ms poll returned false; pageA snapshot at that time confirmed only Alice's message). It appeared only later. Additionally, messages were duplicated many times in both contexts' message lists (re-appended on each update cycle). Verification not marked non-fatal -> fatal -> step 0 points, test plan fails, remaining steps not performed.
test_dm_flow: NOT PERFORMED due to fatal failure in step 2. 0 points.
